title: Northwest Airlines pilot's telepathic encounter

tellings.quote: interviewing this guy who was a former I think he was a North Northwest Airlines

plain: A former airline pilot, who James Fox thinks flew for Northwest Airlines, is said to have had an encounter in Arizona in which something reached him by telepathy, meaning mind to mind without spoken words. The UFO investigator James Fox tells it from his own interview with the pilot, though he gives no date or details of what passed between them. If true, it would mean a trained aviator says he was contacted directly by whatever he met.
